data.one_liner: Native iOS and macOS Liquid Glass widgets using native platform views.
data.what_it_does: Provides native Apple UI components and Liquid Glass effects for iOS and macOS using native platform views. Includes buttons, tab bars, sliders, switches, popup menus, and custom icons with pixel-perfect fidelity.
use_when: You need authentic native iOS and macOS UI components and Liquid Glass effects in a Flutter app.
You are building desktop or mobile apps targeting Apple platforms where standard Cupertino widgets fall short.
avoid_when: You are targeting Android or web platforms where native iOS components are not available.
You need to place widgets inside long scrolling lists where platform views cause performance drops.
strengths: Authentic native rendering via platform views for genuine iOS and macOS appearance.
Comprehensive suite of native-styled widgets including buttons, tab bars, sliders, and switches.
Supports Swift Package Manager alongside CocoaPods.
weaknesses: Platform views are more expensive than standard Flutter widgets and can cause jank in long scrolling lists.
Limited strictly to iOS and macOS platforms.
data.setup_notes: No initialization required; automatically resolves under Flutter SPM or CocoaPods.

alternatives.name: cupertino_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer Flutter's built-in Cupertino widgets rather than native platform views.
